verdict.rationale: Telemetry and usage-tracking opt-out is a fair privacy question for a SaaS financial platform that also ships an official CLI and MCP server. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents any telemetry setting, usage-tracking disclosure, or opt-out mechanism for Stripe Treasury or its tooling. The pack mentions the CLI and MCP server only as existing, not their data-collection behavior.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
